origin_description.description: M01–M08 are the eight separate-measure probits in Table 4. Captured models use camp indicators and captured clustering; camp models use a Japan indicator and camp clustering. Controlled models add exactly the stated covariates, missing flags and size quadratic. M09–M12 add both measures and paired ROC comparisons; M13–M20 add officer main effect and officer-by-hierarchy product. M21–M29 are explicitly described ancillary families with missing numerical tables. D01/D02 are descriptive/illustrative and not regression alternatives.

incompatible_crossings.description: Camp-level hierarchy cannot be estimated alongside unrestricted camp fixed effects; those are constant within camp. Captured models retain camp fixed effects.
Rank count and rank sum replacements only cross controlled specifications containing cohort size, per article; do not cross them with simple models as equivalents.
Do not vary control lists within the equivalent set. Country-specific models omit constant power indicator only as a collinearity necessity.

Complete-case and missing-indicator approaches are distinct sample regimes, not simultaneous choices for the same missing record. Group reference and composition choices must remain internally consistent.
The two cohort definitions and alternative hierarchy constructs retain separate scientific estimands. Executed is descriptive/restriction coding, not an interchangeable survival outcome.
No pay-based or exact entry-date model is executable without missing documentary inputs. Missing coordinates block distance-dependent exact reconstruction; do not fill from numerical targets.

notes.description: Wider grid OFF: this reader identifies decisions, not permission to execute their Cartesian product. Origins marked uncertain identify missing implementation detail rather than confirmed alternatives. No logit, arbitrary control deletion, winsorization, random-effects, or unexplained specification-count quota is introduced. Article is the basis throughout; locally supplied field metadata explains feasibility. Bibliographic methodological papers were not supplied and were not independently consulted.
